newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia TRI denies management problems.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia TRI denies management problems.

text.p: Malaysian telecommunications company Technology Resources Industries Bhd (TRI) on Tuesday denied a newspaper report that it and a major subsidiary company were having management problems.

In a statement to local newspaper papers TRI described as baseless the "rumours and negative reports" on the management of Cellular Communications Network (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd (Celcom), the New Straits Times reported.
TRI group executive vice-president Wan Aishah Wan Hamid was quoted as saying both TRI and Celcom were not facing problems that might have an impact on their operations and management.
She said the newspaper report was inaccurate and may have negative implications on the reputation and business of TRI and Celcom, Business Times reported.
